crossRefs.note: Leah said, “How fortunate!” She named him Gad.
The sons of Zilpah (Leah’s servant): Gad and Asher. These are the sons of Jacob, who were born to him in Paddan Aram.
“A troop will press on Gad, but he will press on their heel.
Of Benjamin: Abidan the son of Gideoni.
Of the children of Gad, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the…
those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Gad, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.
The sons of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites; of Haggi, the family of the Haggites; of…
About Gad he said, “He who enlarges Gad is blessed. He dwells as a lioness, and tears the arm and the crown of the head.
He provided the first part for himself, for the lawgiver’s portion reserved was reserved for him. He came with the…
Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
The sons of Gad lived beside them, in the land of Bashan to Salecah:
The sons of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites; of Haggi, the family of the Haggites; of…

parallels.note: of Arod, the family of the Arodites; of Areli, the family of the Arelites.
